messaging.link_invalid_title: This link is no longer valid
messaging.link_invalid_text: The appointment is over or the link is not correct. Please contact the clinic if you need help.
messaging.is_confirmed: Your appointment is confirmed. We look forward to seeing you.
messaging.cancel_confirm: Your appointment will be cancelled and the time given to another patient.
messaging.locked: Changes less than {n} hours before the appointment can only be made by phone.
messaging.change_by_phone: To change this appointment, call the clinic:
messaging.closed_text: This appointment can no longer be changed online.
messaging.private_link: This is your personal link — do not share it.

done.confirmed: Thank you — your appointment is confirmed.
done.stopped: You will no longer receive automatic messages from this clinic.

messaging.no_slots: No free times on this day. Please choose another day.
messaging.pick_time: Choose one of the free times.
messaging.stop_text: You will no longer receive booking confirmations, reminders or review requests from this clinic by WhatsApp, SMS or e-mail. The clinic can still call you about your appointments.
messaging.stopped_text: This clinic will not send you automatic messages any more. You can turn them on again at any time.

text.confirmation: {clinic}: your appointment with {doctor} is booked for {date} at {time}. Confirm, change or cancel: {link}
text.reminder: Reminder from {clinic}: your appointment with {doctor} is on {date} at {time}. Confirm, change or cancel: {link}
text.review: Thank you for visiting {clinic}. How was your visit with {doctor}? Rate it in one minute: {link}
text.stop_hint: Reply STOP to stop these messages.
text.test: Test message from {clinic}: messages to patients are set up correctly.

mail.confirmation_body: Your appointment with {doctor} is booked for {date} at {time}. You can confirm, change or cancel it from the button below.
mail.reminder_body: This is a reminder of your appointment with {doctor} on {date} at {time}. Please confirm your attendance, or change or cancel it from the button below.
mail.review_body: Thank you for visiting {clinic}. How was your visit with {doctor}? Your rating helps other patients and takes one minute.

messaging.wa_note: Opens WhatsApp on this device with the message ready. You send it yourself.
messaging.settings_lead: Booking confirmations, reminders before the appointment and review requests after the visit — by WhatsApp, SMS or e-mail.
messaging.status_sub: Messages go by WhatsApp first; SMS is used when WhatsApp is not set up or fails; e-mail is added when the patient has an address.

ch_help.whatsapp: WhatsApp Business Cloud API with approved templates.

messaging.fallback_text: Until WhatsApp or SMS is set up, staff can open a ready-made WhatsApp message with the patient's link from the appointment page and the front desk (“WhatsApp” button).
messaging.what_sub: Messages contain only the clinic name, the doctor, the date and time, and the patient's personal link — never medical information.
messaging.opt_confirmations_help: Right after a booking (online or by staff), with a link to confirm, change or cancel.
messaging.opt_reminders_help: Only the latest due reminder is sent; nothing after the appointment starts.
messaging.opt_reviews_help: Sent once after the visit is completed or paid. Only patients who visited can review.
messaging.self_sub: What patients can do from their personal link.
messaging.cutoff_help: Hours before the appointment after which cancelling or moving it online is no longer possible (0 = until the start).
messaging.opt_reschedule_help: To a free time of the same doctor and service. Online consultations are moved by the clinic.
messaging.channels_sub: Turn a channel off without deleting its settings.
messaging.use_whatsapp_help: Template messages through the WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
messaging.use_sms_help: Used when WhatsApp is not set up or a WhatsApp message fails.
messaging.use_email_help: Also sent when the patient has an e-mail address.
messaging.email_not_set: E-mail is not set up on this server yet (SMTP).
messaging.default_dial_help: Numbers written like 0791234567 are sent as +962791234567.
messaging.wa_sub: From your app in Meta for Developers → WhatsApp → API setup.
messaging.wa_phone_id_help: The numeric ID of your WhatsApp business number (not the number itself).
messaging.wa_token_help: A permanent token of a system user with the whatsapp_business_messaging permission. Stored encrypted.
messaging.secret_saved: Saved ({hint}). Leave empty to keep it.
messaging.lang_help: As approved in WhatsApp Manager, e.g. ar, en or en_US.
messaging.quick_confirm: The reminder template has a “Confirm” quick-reply button first
messaging.quick_confirm_help: Patients then confirm with one tap inside WhatsApp (needs the webhook below).
messaging.tpl_show: Template texts to submit for approval
messaging.tpl_intro: Create these three templates (category: Utility) in both languages with the same name. Body variables in this order; one “Visit website” button with a dynamic URL.

tpl.confirmation_ar: تم حجز موعدك في {{1}} مع {{2}} يوم {{3}} الساعة {{4}}. يمكنك تأكيد الموعد أو تغييره أو إلغاؤه من الزر أدناه.
tpl.confirmation_en: Your appointment at {{1}} with {{2}} is booked for {{3}} at {{4}}. You can confirm, change or cancel it with the button below.
tpl.reminder_ar: تذكير: موعدك في {{1}} مع {{2}} يوم {{3}} الساعة {{4}}. يُرجى تأكيد حضورك أو تغيير الموعد أو إلغاؤه من الزر أدناه.
tpl.reminder_en: Reminder: your appointment at {{1}} with {{2}} is on {{3}} at {{4}}. Please confirm your attendance, or change or cancel it with the button below.
tpl.review_ar: شكرًا لزيارتك {{1}}. كيف كانت زيارتك مع {{2}}؟ تقييمك يساعد المرضى الآخرين ولا يستغرق أكثر من دقيقة.
tpl.review_en: Thank you for visiting {{1}}. How was your visit with {{2}}? Your rating helps other patients and takes one minute.

messaging.webhook_help: In Meta for Developers → WhatsApp → Configuration, set this callback URL and verify token, and subscribe to “messages”. Paste the app secret (App settings → Basic) so replies can be verified.
messaging.webhook_after_save: The callback URL appears after you save these settings once.
messaging.app_secret_help: Used to check that replies really come from Meta. Stored encrypted.
messaging.sms_sub: Any provider with an HTTP API (for example Unifonic, Twilio or a local gateway).
messaging.sms_body_help: Use {to} for the number (digits with country code) and {text} for the message. For GET, these become query parameters.
messaging.sms_inbound_help: If your provider can forward replies, point it here (fields from/text) so STOP works by SMS too.
messaging.preview_sub: The text used for SMS and e-mail. WhatsApp uses your approved templates with the same details.
messaging.test_sub: Sends the reminder template (or an SMS) to a number you choose. Save your settings first.
messaging.test_needs: Set up WhatsApp or SMS above to send a test.
messaging.test_fail: The test could not be sent.
messaging.test_phone_invalid: Enter a valid mobile number with the country code.
messaging.log_sub: The last 200 messages — status only; message texts are not stored.
messaging.log_empty_text: Sent confirmations, reminders and review requests appear here.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.lead: Verified reviews from patients after their visit. Reviews cannot be edited or deleted — reply publicly, or report one to the platform.
reviews.empty_text: After a visit, patients receive a link to rate it (Settings → Messages & reminders).
reviews.reply_ph: Thank the patient, or explain what you will improve.
reviews.reply_help: Shown under the review on your clinic page. One reply per review; it cannot be changed later.
reviews.reply_confirm: Your reply will be published under the review and cannot be changed.
reviews.report_reason: Why should this review be checked?
reviews.report_ph: e.g. offensive language, not about this clinic, personal information…
reviews.report_help: The platform team checks the review. It stays visible until they decide.
reviews.reported_ok: Thank you — the review was sent for checking.
reviews.rule_verified: Only patients who actually visited can review, once per visit.
reviews.rule_no_edit: Nobody at the clinic can edit or delete a review.
reviews.rule_reply: You can reply publicly once to each review.
reviews.rule_report: Abusive reviews can be reported; the platform may hide them with a reason.
reviews.public_sub: Only from patients who visited the clinic.
reviews.comment_ph: What went well, and what could be better?
reviews.comment_help: Please do not include medical details or phone numbers.
reviews.privacy: Your phone number, e-mail and visit details are never shown. Your review appears on the clinic's page.
reviews.thanks_text: Your review helps other patients choose {clinic}.
reviews.already_text: Thank you — a review for this visit has already been sent.
reviews.not_visited_text: Only patients who visited the clinic can review. This link will work once your visit is completed.

admin.title: Patient reviews
admin.lead: Reviews reported by clinics come first. Hide abusive reviews with a reason; nothing is ever deleted.
admin.hide_confirm: The review will no longer be shown on the clinic page. The clinic sees it as hidden with your reason.
admin.reason_ph: Reason shown to the clinic (e.g. offensive language, personal data)
admin.show_confirm: The review will be visible on the clinic page again.

errors_engage.ENGAGE_CLOSED: This appointment can no longer be changed online. Please contact the clinic.
errors_engage.ENGAGE_CUTOFF: It is too close to the appointment to change it online. Please call the clinic.
errors_engage.MESSAGING_NOT_CONFIGURED: Set up WhatsApp or an SMS provider first.
errors_engage.MESSAGING_NO_APP_KEY: Credentials cannot be stored until APP_KEY is set on the server.
errors_engage.MESSAGING_NO_PHONE: This patient has no valid mobile number.
errors_engage.REVIEW_EXISTS: This visit has already been reviewed.
errors_engage.REVIEW_NOT_VISITED: Only patients who visited the clinic can review.
errors_engage.REVIEW_REPLIED: This review already has a reply.
errors_engage.REVIEW_REPORTED: This review has already been reported.
errors_engage.SLOT_TAKEN: This time was just taken. Please choose another time.
errors_engage.SLOT_BUSY: The system is busy — please try again.
errors_engage.ALREADY_PAID: This visit is already paid and can no longer be moved online.
